# A move-out costs the gap, not the rent.

> Price an existing-customer rate increase (ECRI) at your storage facility: what one induced move-out really costs once the unit re-rents at street rate, and the move-out rate at which the increase stops paying. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
